content:
Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

Basic Pay plus Deputation (Duty) Allowance shall not exceed the Basic Pay in the Apex Level i.e. t 2,25,000. In the case of Government servants receiving Non-Practising Allowance, their Basic Pay plus Non-Practising Allowance plus Deputation (Duty) Allowance shall not exceed the average of Basic Pay of the revised scale applicable to the Apex Level and the Level of the Cabinet Secretary i.e. < 2,37,500.
